title: Vampire Vape Blueberry 10ml E-Liquid
description: The Vampire Vape Blueberry E-Liquid is a luscious juicy E-Liquid that’s perfect for any vaper seeking to enjoy a rich yet juicy vape. This is classic E-Liquid flavour that never goes out of style. Blueberry by Vampire Vape offers luscious tasting vape bursting with authentic rich, sweet and tangy blueberries. Each juicy puff delivers a burst of blueberry flavour delivered through a super smooth throat hit. It's a great all day vape flavour that slots into any vapers fruity E-Liquid collection. This E-Liquid from Vampire Vape offers a perfect balance of PG and VG, providing maximum flavour and satisfying clouds. Please note: that the 3mg nicotine strength contains 50VG/50PG while 0mg, 6mg, 12mg & 18mg nicotine strengths contain 40VG/60PG. They are versatile enough to be used with most vape devices but are ideal for low-powered starter kits , pen-vape kits and pod kits . If you love this delicious Vampire Vape E-Liquid 10ml, then why not check out the other equally moreish flavours from their collection. They have a multitude of delicious flavours to choose from to suit any vaper’s flavour requirements. Go ahead and try out their juicy fruit flavours, refreshing beverage, sweet bakery, confectionary and dessert flavours or even their classic Mint/Menthol and tobacco flavours.
